audit.why: 48.99% over 745 games is honestly even and the content layer's whys describe exactly that arc — Graves owns 1-3, it evens at 4-5, Yi takes 6 and the late game. No difficulty fields exist to correct: this matchup has no full-layer entry at all.

The content chart already matches the packet chart row for row: Graves / Graves / Graves / Skill / Master Yi / Skill / Master Yi. This is the only matchup in my slice where the level chart needed no repair.
audit.corrected: Spike text left in place but re-anchored to real numbers — Alpha Strike's 20s and Highlander's 85s — since the packet flags no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere on the page.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page's central late-game instruction is 'a blinded Yi mid-Highlander is a dead Yi'. It is wrong twice over. Smoke Screen is not a blind — it reduces sight range and slows on impact — and Highlander explicitly makes Master Yi IMMUNE TO ALL SLOWING EFFECTS, so during his ultimate the only half of W that still functions is the vision cut.
audit.why: This is the worst error in my whole slice, because it is the plan: the page tells you to save your 26-second W for the exact window in which most of it stops working. A Graves player holding smoke for the dive gets a Yi who neither misses nor slows.
audit.corrected: Restated as the sight-range cut, with the slow immunity stated plainly so the player knows which half survives and when.

audit.whatIsWrong: Alpha Strike's untargetability is never mentioned, and neither is Wuju Style's true damage.
audit.why: Two things follow that the page gets backwards. He is untargetable for the whole Alpha Strike dash, so a Collateral Damage or a magazine spent into it is simply thrown away — and the page's 'blind the Alpha Strike return window' had the player acting during the one window he cannot be touched. And Wuju Style grants bonus TRUE damage on his basic attacks, which is precisely what the Armor and Magic Resist from Quickdraw cannot reduce, so stacking True Grit and standing there is not a plan.
audit.corrected: Both written into the mid and late blocks, with Alpha Strike's 20-second cooldown and the fact that his basic attacks shorten it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Meditate is a channel that any CC cancels — but Graves has no CC to cancel it with.
audit.why: Worth stating as a negative only because the page implies burst beats it. Nothing in Graves' kit stuns, roots or knocks back a champion (his passive knocks back non-champions only), so he cannot interrupt Meditate at all, and Meditate additionally PAUSES the remaining duration on Wuju Style and Highlander — meaning Yi can channel out your cooldowns and resume his ultimate. Waiting him out is not neutral, it is losing.
audit.corrected: Folded into the mid block as the reason to disengage rather than wait.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Buckshot' is used four times as a Graves ability, including 'Wall-bounced Buckshots'.
audit.why: Graves has no ability called Buckshot. His passive is New Destiny, the four-pellet spread; his Q is End of the Line, a single explosive shell that detonates after 1 second or on terrain contact — it does not bounce off walls and come back.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the real names and the real behaviour.

edits.after: His 6 is the warning bell — Highlander makes him immune to every slow you own, so smoke stops kiting him, and Meditate has no answer in your kit: you carry no CC to break the channel, and it pauses the clock on Highlander while he heals. Alpha Strike is the real read — 20 seconds, shortened by his basic attacks, and he is untargetable the whole dash, so a shell fired into it is thrown away. Punish the landing, not the leap.
